name: Modelize Home
summary:
Modelize Home makes property visualization simple so you can be immersed in the details that matter. Whether you’re a homeowner, CGI artist, developer, architect or sales agent-step into a future home before it's even built and see dreams realized in real time.
Modelize Home enables you to explore immersive spaces created from your floor plans or property models, ensuring your vision is communicated effectively and managed seamlessly. Available on any device, Modelize Home allows you to access your projects
